assumption: Abandoning the shared state in the destructor when in an unsatisfied state leads to an orphaned result in the associated Future.
rationale: SWS_CORE_06349 documents abandoning as "abandons any shared state", whereas the concrete subsequent behavior on the Future follows the semantics of std::promise.
